string.body: Contains a Mini Mobile - Movement Speed (30 days).\nTemporarily gives your mount increased movement speed, but the ride time is shortened.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDER_WOLF_02_30DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDER_TIGER_02_30DAY_DESC
string.body: Contains a White Tiger - Resist Magic (30 days).\nTemporarily enhances your mount's ability to resist magic, but the ride time is shortened.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDER_LION_02_30DAY_DESC
string.body: Contains a Lion - Dodge Enemy (30 days).\nTemporarily enhances your mount's ability to dodge enemies, but the ride time is shortened.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDE_UNICORN_03_30DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDE_ICESTORE_COLORED_HORSE_02_30DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDE_SHEEPRIDE_02_30DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDE_SPACEHOVER_02_30DAY_DESC
string.body: Contains a Space Glider - Physical defence (30 days).\nTemporarily gives your mount enhanced physical defence, but the ride time is shortened.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDE_SCOOTER_02_30DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDE_SHUGOPLANE_02_30DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDE_BRICKRABBIT_02_30DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_CASH_RIDE_ROCKET_03_30DAY_DESC

string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_AP_M_40P_65LV_WE_DESC
string.body:
If you use it to dismantle your Abyss armour, you will get back 40%% of the purchase price as Abyss Points.
First, double-click on the tool, then select an item to dismantle.
Only Abyss armour whose appearance has been modified can be extracted.
Can be used on mythical weapons up to level 65.

string.body: Packaging Scroll for Accessories and Headwear (Level 80; Mythical)

string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_PACK_WE_M_80A_DESC
string.body:
Can be used on packable mythical (or lesser) weapons up to level 80 so that they can be traded afterwards.
The packaged item can only be traded once.
Double-click on the scroll, then select the item to package.
[Notes]
1. If you receive a packaged item, it is unpacked automatically.
2. If you wear a packaged item, it will be unpacked automatically and the amount of approved packaging will be used up accordingly.
3. If you have packaged an item and you receive it again, it remains packaged (e.g. when cancelling an auction registration, when the time limit is exceeded during registration, when taking back items from the private shop, when a transaction is cancelled, when processing or returning items in the post, or when posting to yourself).
4. Packaging possible: items that have received additional packaging after enchantment, manastone socketing, DP augmentation, magic augmentation, Idian enhancement, plastic surgery, or from Enchantment Level 20.
5. Packaging not possible: for items that have been armed or already packed, during stacking, Armsfusion, and prior to identification.
6. The following actions are not possible in packaged state: extraction, enchantment, manastone socketing, godstone socketing, Idian enhancement, DP augmentation, magic augmentation, dyeing and plastic surgery, manastone removal, colour or secondary weapon, Armsfusion.

string.name: STR_CASH_QSHOP_MATTER_ENCHANT_STIGMA_DESC
string.body:
Can enchant certain Stigmas.
If the enchantment is successful, the level is increased by 1. There is a slight possibility that the level may also increase by 2 or 3.
If the attempt fails, the level is reduced by 1. There is a slight possibility that the previous level will remain unchanged.
Activate the Stigma Enchantment Stone by double-clicking or right-clicking it, and then select the Stigma you want to enchant.

string.name: STR_CASH_KISK_LIGHT_PARTY_SMALL_HIDE_01_DESC
string.body:
Summons a camouflaged Kisk which resurrects the fallen at its location. It lasts for 2 hours, can be activated by up to 6 people and allows 18 resurrections.
Only usable by members of the same group as the Spiritmaster.
You can change the mode of a disguised Kisk again when you use the "Penetrate" or "Searching Eye" skills.
The player who positions it remains semi-transparent.
Once you position it, the time remaining until you can reuse it is displayed.

string.name: STR_INGAME_MATTER_ENCHANT_STIGMA_DESC
string.body:
Can enchant certain Stigmas.
If the enchantment is successful, the level is increased by 1. There is a slight possibility that the level may also increase by 2 or 3.
If the attempt fails, the level is reduced by 1. There is a slight possibility that the previous level will remain unchanged.
Activate the Stigma Enchantment Stone by double-clicking or right-clicking it, and then select the Stigma you want to enchant.

string.name: STR_CASH_BIND_SPECIAL_UNSEAL_01_DESC
string.body: This scroll can break the seal of an item.\n Once the scroll is used, the item is unsealed.\nActivate the scroll by double-clicking or right-clicking it and then select the item to unseal.

string.name: STR_QINASHOP_NORMAL_UNSEAL_SCROLL_01_DESC

string.name: STR_EVENT_REWARD_MATTER_ENCHANT_STIGMA_DESC
string.body:
Can enchant certain Stigmas.
If the enchantment is successful, the level is increased by 1. There is a slight possibility that the level may also increase by 2 or 3.
If the attempt fails, the level is reduced by 1. There is a slight possibility that the previous level will remain unchanged.
Activate the Stigma Enchantment Stone by double-clicking or right-clicking it, and then select the Stigma you want to enchant.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.body: Contains a level 80 Ancient Manastone for Physical Attack, Crit Strike, Accuracy, HP, Block or Resist Magic.\nDouble-click to open.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_DEVA_TITLEBOX_01
string.body: [Event] Selection Box: Daeva Champion Title (15 days)

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_DEVA_TITLEBOX_01_DESC
string.body: Contains the title of Daeva Champion (15 days).\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_DEVA_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body: Bestows the title <Brave Daeva Champion>.\nThis title increases your movement speed by 5%%, your attack speed by 2%%, your crit strike by 10, and your additional PvP attack by 20 points.\nValid for 15 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_DEVA_TITLE_02_DESC
string.body: Bestows the title <Wise Daeva Champion>.\nThis title increases your movement speed by 5%%, your casting speed by 2%%, your crit spell by 10, and your additional PvP attack by 20 points.\nValid for 15 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_DEVA_TITLE_03_DESC
string.body: Bestows the title <Astute Daeva Champion>.\nThis title increases your movement speed by 5%%, your attack speed by 2%%, your crit spell by 10, and your additional PvP attack by 20 points.\nValid for 15 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_FOR10_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body: Bestows the title <Weed Challenger>.\nThis title increases your movement speed by 5%%, your attack speed by 2%%, your casting speed by 2%%, and your additional PvE attack by 100.\nValid for 7 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_FOOD_HP_MP_CRITICAL_02_DESC
string.body: [%e1.StatUp.StatName] is increased by [%e1.StatUp.Value] points, [%e2.StatUp.StatName] by [%e2.StatUp.Value] points, [%e3.StatUp.StatName] by [%e3.StatUp.Value] points and [%e4.StatUp.StatName] by [%e4.StatUp.Value] points for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_CASH_DRINK_HP_MP_REGEN_02_DESC
string.body: [%e1.StatUp.StatName] is increased by [%e1.StatUp.Value] points and [%e2.StatUp.StatName] is increased by [%e2.StatUp.Value] points for [%e1.StatUp.RemainTime].

string.name: STR_CASH_ITEM_COOKIE_STAT_SPECIAL_DESC
string.body: Increases attack speed by 1%%, casting speed by 1%%, movement speed by 1%%, max. HP by 3,000, crit strike by 110, crit spell by 110, accuracy by 220 and magical accuracy by 220 points for 60 minutes.\nThe effect remains even after death.

string.name: STR_CASH_ITEM_COOKIE_BUFF_SPECIAL_DESC
string.body: Increases XP by 35%%, AP by 35%% and the chance of loot by 25%% for 60 minutes.\nThe effect remains even after death.

string.name: STR_SALE_F8_LEGION_EVERYTIME_DESC
string.body: There is a buying limit on this item. Items that are sold out will be replenished every day after the Altar Siege Battle.

string.name: STR_EVENT_FOR10_WING_PHY_80A_DESC
string.body: Wings to commemorate the 10th anniversary of Daeva Day.\nApparently, they bring the owner good luck.

string.name: STR_ITEM_IDINFINITY_ALL_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body: Bestows the title <The Most Powerful in the Tower of Challenge>.\nThis title increases your movement speed by 5%%, your attack speed by 3%%, your casting speed by 3%% and your HP by 500.\nValid for 7 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_IDINFINITY_ALL_TITLE_02_DESC
string.body: Bestows the title <Conqueror of the Tower of Challenge>.\nThis title increases your movement speed by 4%%, your attack speed by 2%%, your casting speed by 2%% and your HP by 300.\nValid for 7 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_IDINFINITY_ALL_TITLE_03_DESC
string.body: Bestows the title <Multitalent of the Tower of Challenge>.\nThis title increases your movement speed by 3%%, your attack speed by 1%%, your casting speed by 1%%.\nValid for 7 days.

string.body: You can exchange this treasure with Lugbug for 30,000 AP.\nYou cannot sell it if you have reached the maximum number of Abyss Points for your current level.\nThis treasure disappears again after a while.

string.name: STR_LUGBUG_AP_TREASURE_02_7DAY_DESC
string.body: You can exchange this treasure with Lugbug for 70,000 AP.\nYou cannot sell it if you have reached the maximum number of Abyss Points for your current level.\nThis treasure disappears again after a while.

string.name: STR_LUGBUG_TRANS_CONTRACT_02_DESC

string.name: STR_LUGBUG_CUSTOMDYE_01_DESC
string.body: Dyes an item any colour.\nDouble-click (or right-click) to activate it, and then select the item you want to dye.

string.name: STR_LUGBUG_CUSTOMIZE_01_60M_DESC
string.body: You can change your face and your physique.\nGo to the Clothing tab in the Gold Sand shop and click on the Modify Appearance button.\nCan only be used in cities.

string.name: STR_POTION_INVINCIBLE_LUGBUG_UNDER75_DESC
string.body: You are protected from damage for 20 seconds.

string.name: STR_LUGBUG_ITEM_EXTRACTION_01_DESC
string.body: You receive more Slot Stones when you use this Socketing Aid during equipment extractions.

string.name: STR_LUGBUG_SCROLL_START_KIT_01C_1D_DESC
string.body: No Soul Sickness and you keep all your XP if you die. Soul healing, flight or teleport costs just 1 Kinah. Higher-level soul healing will cost extra.\nThe effect lasts for 1 hour.

string.name: STR_LUGBUG_MINION_CONTRACT_A_CHERIBUM_1_100_DESC
string.body: A Class A minion contract for an Arch Kerubiel.\nDouble-click to open and become the proud owner of a summoned minion.

string.name: STR_LUGBUG_ABSOLUTEAP_RECOVERY_250000_DESC
string.body: Restores the Silver Star Energy.\nRegenerates more energy than the normal Silver Star.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_KEY_IDAB1_ERE_SPRISONKEY_EVENT_02_DESC
string.body: A lubricant for moving the lever of the New Start Cage at the Sakra Prison Camp.

string.name: STR_SKILL_IDAB1_ERE_BOMB_EVENT_01_DESC
string.body: A bomb built from a primitive fuse and primitive gunpowder. It can be used once you have destroyed the most critical facilities at the Sakra Prison Camp.

string.name: STR_KEY_IDAB1_ERE_CLEARKEY_EVENT_01_DESC

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_01_DESC
string.body: My name is Graa, Daeva of Boasts.\nI was once a Zephyr Daeva, but then it was all over one day.\nDo you want to know how it came to that?

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_02_DESC
string.body: On 1st April last year, Daevas dispatched to the instance to look for legendary weapons asked me this:\n'Graa, when can we enter the instance again?'\nMy answer was: 'Try to solve this riddle. This is your last chance.'

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_03_DESC
string.body:
'This is the first puzzle:
How many altars are there in Dumaha?
The second puzzle: When does the battle against the Guardian Generals begin?
The last puzzle is this: How many Stigma sockets does a Daeva have?'
But the Daevas couldn't answer these simple questions. So you couldn't enter the instance again and had to wait outside.

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_04_DESC
string.body: Can you solve this riddle? You should surely be capable of that since you've been to Atreia before.\nThe solutions to these three riddles are easy to find, but I won't tell you how to piece them together and what benefits await you. Otherwise it would be too easy, right?

string.name: STR_EVENT_APRIL_FOOL_NOTE_05_DESC
string.body: Are you frustrated? Then I'll give you a hint:\nThe answer is 'time'. And my favourite date is 1st April.\nBut don't rely too much on what I say.

string.name: STR_KEY_LDF5_TREASURE_BOX_R_01_DESC
string.body: This key unlocks the Legion's Legendary Treasure Chest in Red Katalam.\nThe Legion's Legendary Treasure Chest appears at a random location in Red Katalam.

string.name: STR_KEY_LDF5_TREASURE_BOX_F_01_DESC
string.body: This key unlocks the Legion's Ultimate Treasure Chest in Red Katalam.\nThe Legion's Ultimate Treasure Chest appears at a random location in Red Katalam.

string.name: STR_WING_MISSION_PVP_R2_A_78A_DESC

You need to use 'Concentrated Crystal of Ambition' as the upgrade material. Elyos obtain it during the 'Inanna's Determination' campaign and Asmodians obtain it during the 'Inanna's Will' campaign.

The Wings of War will be upgraded by 2 points regardless of your enchantment value.

The Magic Wings will be upgraded by 2 points regardless of your enchantment value.

Once opened, the chest can be used for 30 days.
Double-click to open.

The 'Ascend/Sprint' button activates Sprint mode.
This consumes Flight Time.
Can be used for 15 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_CATCH_RIDE_SELECTIVE
string.body: [Event] Mount Box of Consumables from the Daeva Era

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_CATCH_RIDE_SELECTIVE_DESC
string.body: Contains [Event] Cheese Cat (15 days), [Event] Cotton Candy Cat (15 days), [Event] Mini Mobile (15 days) and [Event] Black Mini Mobile (15 days).\nDouble-click to open.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_CHATCH_TITLE_15DAYS_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <Daeva Era>.
This title increases your attack speed by 2%%, your casting speed by 2%%, your movement speed by 4%% and your HP by 415.
Valid for 15 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_CATCHITEM_GOODS_01
string.body: [Event] Bundle of Consumables from the Daeva Era

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_CATCHITEM_GOODS_01_DESC
string.body: Contains various consumables.\nDouble-click to open.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_CATCHITEM_TRANS_POTION_GRADE04_03
string.body: [Event] Selection Box of Transformation Potions from the Daeva Era

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_CATCHITEM_ENCHANT_RECEIPT_01_DESC
string.body: If you select an item in your possession and request help, the item will be enchanted with +15. Time limits are published on the event page.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_CATCHITEM_ENCHANT_RECEIPT_001_DESC
string.body: If you select an item and a Manastone in your possession and request help, the item will be enchanted. Time limits are published on the event page.

string.name: STR_MATERIAL_KEY_LDF5_TREASURE_A_01_DESC
string.body: This material is used in magical crafting.\nYou can use magical crafting to obtain Ancient Alchemium and, with a lesser probability, Bundles of Katalam Garrison Crystals.

string.name: STR_MATERIAL_KEY_LDF5_TREASURE_R_01_DESC
string.body: This material is used in magical crafting.\nYou can use magical crafting to obtain Legendary Alchemium and, with a lesser probability, Bundles of Noble Katalam Garrison Crystals.

string.name: STR_MATERIAL_KEY_LDF5_TREASURE_F_01_DESC
string.body: This material is used in magical crafting.\nYou can use magical crafting to obtain Ultimate Alchemium and, with a lesser probability, Bundles of Noble Katalam Crystal Keys

string.name: STR_COIN_LDF5_R_80A_DESC
string.body: This insignia is available in Katalam.\nSee the <Merchant for Katalam rewards> at the Rebuilt Tower of Light or the Rune Temple in Katalam to exchange it for an Equipment Chest of Intense Battle or a Legendary Katalam Insignia Chest.

string.name: STR_COIN_LDF5_F_80A_DESC
string.body: This insignia is available in Katalam.\nSee the <Merchant for Katalam rewards> at the Rebuilt Tower of Light or the Rune Temple in Katalam to exchange it for a Red Katalam Equipment Chest or an Ultimate Katalam Treasure Chest.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EXP_COIN_80A_DESC
string.body: Extract the character's XP to obtain this Insignia.\nThe Insignia of Experience lets you influence the outcome when dismantling Raffle Chests or buy Glory reward items from a merchant. To extract a character's XP, you require a Combat Experience Extractor, which you can purchase from Supplies Quartermasters in Inggison and Gelkmaros or from General Traders in Lakrum and Dumaha.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_COIN_LDF5_PIECE_R_80A_DESC
string.body: A Legendary Battle Insignia Fragment.\nCollect multiple fragments and double-click on them to assemble them.

string.name: STR_ASSEMBLY_COIN_LDF5_PIECE_F_80A_DESC
string.body: An Ultimate Battle Insignia Fragment.\nCollect multiple fragments and double-click on them to assemble them.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EXP_EXTRACTION_80A_DESC
string.body: A tool for extracting Insignias of Experience.\nMay be purchased from the Supplies Quartermasters in Inggison and Gelkmaros or from the General Traders in Lakrum and Dumaha.\nYou can use it once your character has acquired more than 175,000,000 XP. Using it consumes XP and creates an Insignia of Experience.

string.name: STR_EVENT_COIN_FOUNTAIN_PVP_STATUP_01_DESC
string.body: Increases your additional PvP attack by 50 points for 60 seconds.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_EVENT_COIN_FOUNTAIN_PVE_STATUP_01_DESC

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_SAMGYETANG_BOX_01_DESC
string.body:
This stew will drive away the heat and make you strong.
Double-click to open. 
Valid for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_JULY_SUMMERHUNTING_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <Heat Day>.
This title increases your movement speed by 4%%, your HP by 200, your attack speed by 3%% and your casting speed by 3%%.
Valid for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_JULY_LAW0717_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <Law-Abiding Citizen>.
This title increases your movement speed by 5%%, your MP by 200, your physical defence by 15 and your magic defence by 15 points.
Valid for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_EVENT_JULY_CHICKENRIDER_01_30DAY_DESC
string.body:
Cock-a-doodle-doo! This is Cluck. 
Use this item to mount and dismount. 
The 'Ascend/Sprint' button activates Sprint mode. This consumes your flight time. 
The mount is valid for 30 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_KISK_LDF5_LIGHT_PRIVATE_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk which resurrects the fallen at its location. It lasts for 20 hours and has a cooldown time of 1 minutes.\nOnly the caster can use the Kisk.\nCan only be used in Katalam.

string.name: STR_KISK_LDF5_LIGHT_PARTY_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk which resurrects the fallen at its location. It lasts for 20 minutes and can be activated by up to 6 people.\nOnly usable by members of the same group as the summoner.\nCan only be used in Katalam.

string.name: STR_KISK_LDF5_LIGHT_FORCE_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk which resurrects the fallen at its location. It lasts for 20 minutes and can be activated by up to 24 people.\nOnly usable by members of the same alliance as the summoner.\nCan only be used in Katalam.

string.name: STR_KISK_LDF5_LIGHT_LEGION_DESC
string.body: Summons a Kisk which resurrects the fallen at its location. It lasts for 20 minutes and can be activated by up to 48 people.\nOnly usable by members of the same legion as the summoner.\nCan only be used in Katalam.

string.body: This emblem proves you were of great assistance to Ramses in protecting Cleo's Soul.\nYou can use it to buy a variety of worldly items.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

By opening the Immortal Mark, you can also obtain consumables.
Double-click to open.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_EVENT_SONGPYEON_SUCCES_DESC
string.body: A delicious cake which has been sweetened with honey.\nPresent it to the Harvest Festival Merchant to get a variety of Moon Rabbit items.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_EVENT_SONGPYEON_FAIL_DESC
string.body: Even a burned honey cake can come in handy.\nHurl it at an enemy to deal damage.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_EVENT_SONGPYEON_RICEPOWDER_DESC
string.body: Rice powder is an ingredient used to bake a honey cake.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_EVENT_SONGPYEON_PINENIDDLES_DESC
string.body: Pine needles are an ingredient used to bake a honey cake.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_EVENT_SONGPYEON_HONEY_DESC
string.body: Honey is an ingredient used to bake a honey cake.\nWhen you eat honey, the Moon Rabbit cheers you on, lending you new strength.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_SONGPYEON_SONGPYEONBOX_N_DESC
string.body: Contains a gift from the Moon Rabbit.\nDouble-click to open.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_WRAP_EVENT_SONGPYEON_SONGPYEONBOX_S_DESC
string.body: Contains a gift from the Moon Rabbit.\nDouble-click to open.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_WEAPON_RAID_PVE_F2_R_80S
string.body: Ultimate Anomos Weapons Selection Box of Wrath

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_WEAPON_RAID_PVE_F2_R_80S_DESC
string.body: Contains an Ultimate Anomos Weapon of Wrath.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WORLD_WRAP_US_MIDAUTUMNDAY_SET_DESC
string.body: Contains a Daru Fur Set.\nDouble-click to open.

string.name: STR_WORLD_DMAHA_MIND_MIND_DESC
string.body: It contains the essence of Dumaha's light.\nThere's a certain probability that you can use it to get a Dumamond or a Dumallond.

string.name: STR_WORLD_DMAHA_MIND_DMAHA_ENERGY_DESC
string.body: Dumaha's bright light makes this stone shine.\nThere's a certain probability that you'll get a special item for it.

string.name: STR_WORLD_DMAHA_MIND_DMAHA_LOST_ENERGY_DESC
string.body: Dumaha's gentle light makes this stone shimmer.\nYou can trade it for goods from Poumerlinerk.

string.name: STR_DMAHA_MIND_DEVA_ENERGY_DESC
string.body: A crystal for Daevas who have earned themselves a reward by defeating the enemy faction.\nBring it and the Dumaha Distillate to Soulinerk to get a Kron Dumamond.

string.name: STR_CASH_BUFF_MATTER_ENCHANT_01_DESC
string.body: For 10 minutes, this cookie guarantees that Manastone Socketing will succeed.\nIf you do not use it for 60 minutes, it will disappear.

string.name: STR_POTION_IDED_01_HP_MP_01_DESC
string.body: Restores [%e1.ProcHeal_Instant.Heal] HP and [%e2.ProcMpHeal_Instant.Heal] MP.\nDisappears when you leave the Shattered Abyssal Splinter.

string.name: STR_ITEM_IDED_DAMAGE_SKILL_01_DESC
string.body: You can use this essence to deal Yamennes Painflare a severe blow.\nDisappears when you leave the Shattered Abyssal Splinter.

string.name: STR_KEY_IDED_01_DOOR_DESC
string.body: This key grants you access to the place where Yamennes Painflare lurks.\nIt disappears when you leave the Abyssal Splinter.

string.name: STR_ITEM_AP_TREASURE_03_7DAY_DESC
string.body: You can exchange this treasure with Lugbug for 250,000 AP.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_AP_TREASURE_02_7DAY_DESC
string.body: You can exchange this treasure with Lugbug for 100,000 AP.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_AP_TREASURE_01_7DAY_DESC
string.body: You can exchange this treasure with Lugbug for 50,000 AP.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_WRAP_IDED_01_PVE_F2_R_80A_ALL_DESC
string.body: An automatic raffle bundle.\nDisappears when you leave the Shattered Abyssal Splinter.

string.name: STR_WRAP_IDED_01_PVE_F2_R_80A_C_DESC
string.body: Contains Abyss Weapons.\nDouble-click to open.\nDisappears when you leave the Shattered Abyssal Splinter.

string.name: STR_WRAP_IDED_01_PVE_F2_R_80A_B_DESC
string.body:
Contains +5 Abyss Weapons.
Double-click to open.
The enchantment level will be applied in your inventory.
Disappears when you leave the Shattered Abyssal Splinter.

string.name: STR_WRAP_IDED_01_PVE_F2_R_80A_A_DESC
string.body:
Contains +10 Abyss Weapons.

string.name: STR_CASH_POINTSHOP_KISK_LIGHT_FORCE_MEDIUM_HIDE_01_DESC
string.body:
Summons a camouflaged Kisk which resurrects the fallen at its location. It lasts for 2 hours, can be activated by up to 24 people and allows 72 resurrections.
Only usable by members of the same alliance as the summoner.
You can change the mode of a disguised Kisk again when you use the "Penetrate" or "Searching Eye" skills.
The player who positions it remains semi-transparent.
Once you position it, the time remaining until you can reuse it is displayed.
This item can be used repeatedly.
Valid for 15 days.

string.name: STR_CASH_POINTSHOP_KISK_DARK_FORCE_MEDIUM_HIDE_01_DESC

This item can be used repeatedly.
Valid for 15 days.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_OCT_1001_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <Solitary Protector>.
This title increases your accuracy by 100 points and your magical accuracy by 100 points.
Valid for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_OCT_1009_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <Expressive>.
This title increases your HP by 1,443 points and your MP by 1,230 points.
Valid for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_NOV_1108_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <Hibernator>.
This title increases your HP by 900 points and your MP by 900 points.
Can be used for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_DEC_1222_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <Night Owl>.
This title increases your physical attack by 88 points and your magic attack by 88 points.
Can be used for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_DEC_1231_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <Soothsayer>.
This title increases your movement speed by 5%% and your HP by 999.
Can be used for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_JAN_0101_TITLE_01
string.body: [Event] [Title Card] All Hail the Rat! (7 days)

string.name: STR_ITEM_EVENT_JAN_0101_TITLE_01_DESC
string.body:
Bestows the title <All Hail the Rat!>.
This title increases your movement speed by 5%%, your attack speed by 5%% and your casting speed by 5%%.
Valid for 7 days.
This item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_COIN_BATTLEFIELD_REWARD_01_DESC
string.body: A coin presented to Daevas on the battlefield. Give it to the Battlefield Briefing Officer in exchange for goods.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF7_SUPPORT_QUEST_BASE_DROP_DESC
string.body: You get the seal by killing the legate of a garrison that has been occupied by another faction. Bring it to the Protectorate's commanding officer and you will get an Order Ticket.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF7_SUPPORT_QUEST_TICKET_L_DESC
string.body: You need this ticket to get Squad Orders. You get it from quests assigned by Karaia, Vice Captain of the Life Debt Legion. If you have accepted a mission, you won't get it back even if you abort the mission.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF7_SUPPORT_QUEST_TICKET_D_DESC
string.body: You need this ticket to get Squad Orders. You get it from quests assigned by Hinden, Vice Captain of the Wise Judgement Legion. If you have accepted a mission, you won't get it back even if you abort the mission.

string.body: Contains a random ultimate Merciless Intruder's accessory.\nDouble-click to open.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.body: Unlocks the <Halloween Spook> emote.\nThis item will disappear at the end of the event.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF8_LEGION_DIGGER_STONE_DESC
string.body: Use it in a 3 m radius around a Winding Tower in Dumaha to designate the tower as the legion's property. Can be purchased from legion merchants.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF5_PANDAROONGS_SHUGO_TRANS_L_DESC
string.body: Transforms you into a Pandarung Shugo so you can use the Pandarung Entrance.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LDF5_PANDAROONGS_SHUGO_TRANS_D_DESC
string.body: Transforms you into a Pandarung Shugo so you can use the Pandarung Entrance.

string.name: STR_ITEM_UNDERPASS_QUEST_ITEM01_DESC
string.body: Processed with softly gleaming Jotun Eyes, you receive a jewel of good quality.

string.name: STR_ITEM_UNDERPASS_QUEST_ITEM02_DESC
string.body: Processed with the Magic Stone from the Anuhart weapon, you receive good quality material for weapons.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LF4_QUEST_ITEM01_DESC
string.body: Known to be the source of the Guardian General's power.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LF4_QUEST_ITEM02_DESC
string.body: Known to be the source of the Guardian General's power.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LF4_QUEST_ITEM03_DESC
string.body: A medal awarded to a Balaur captain for extraordinary services.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LF4_QUEST_ITEM04_DESC
string.body: A Magic Stone with a Land Insignia. If it's processed, the stone can be used for different kinds of magical research.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LF4_QUEST_ITEM05_DESC
string.body: A Magic Stone with a Dark Insignia. If it's processed, the stone can be used for different kinds of magical research.

string.name: STR_ITEM_LF4_QUEST_ITEM06_DESC
string.body: Tiamat's power, distilled into a fine powder. They say it can breathe vitality into magical stones.

string.body:
Can enchant certain Stigmas.
If the enchantment is successful, the level is increased by 1. There is a slight possibility that the level may also increase by 2 or 3.
If the attempt fails, the level is reduced by 1. There is a slight possibility that the previous level will remain unchanged.
Activate the Stigma Enchantment Stone by double-clicking or right-clicking it, and then select the Stigma you want to enchant.
